description: This file defines functions and types for reading and writing API message history related to task persistence, including handling of file I/O, parsing JSON data, and managing conversation history files.

methods.name: readApiMessages
methods.description: Reads API message history for a given task, handling both current and legacy file formats, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: saveApiMessages
methods.description: Saves API message history for a given task to the designated storage file.
